title: Recordings with Cliff Jackson and Cliff as a stride pianist
summary: Campbell mentions a prized 1930 record with Cliff Jackson and other stride piano recordings.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: How about in the way of recordings --

I have numerous recordings but the prize recording I have is one recorded with Maxine Sullivan's late husband, Cliff Jackson, recorded in 1930, which is 50 years ago and on this here album he's playing a thing called 'Horseteathers' and he's playing his E-flat tuba.
Did he make any records on the string bass?

Yes, but I can't remember any to my knowledge. No, I don't have this album but I have Cliff playing the (stride) piano. Oh, this has got Sidney (DeParis), Sidney Bechet, oh this is real big, I'll have to tape this sometime.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
